summary: Iter25: tested the mobile-first Autocadastro redesign at 375x667, 390x844, 412x915 and 1920x800. The PRIORITY bug is fixed for the invite wizard: on every mobile viewport it opens fullscreen (100dvh), and the header, the close X and the footer (invite-next/invite-save) stay visible. This also holds when invite-guest-name has focus and with a simulated keyboard (viewport height minus 300px). All 3 wizard steps work, including validation, +1h/+4h/Fim do dia, the result (WhatsApp/copy/QR/message) and the steps-dots. Invites were created as Admin (mobile), Recepção (desktop) and a TEST_ Gestor (mobile). For the gestor, the invite-no-types warning appeared with Continuar disabled, and after allowed types were set it succeeded with the single company and single type preselected. The public flows all completed with a real face fixture injected through a getUserMedia override: /v/:code, the site QR (company list shows only on focus; preselected when only 1 company), /convite/:token (invite card, no host search, always 'pendente', link single-use), /solicitacao (waiting, aprovado, recusado) and /aprovar (photo/name/reason, identity and blacklist warnings, fixed approve/reject footer, confirmations). Request queue cards with quick Liberar/Recusar/Editar work on mobile, and the table works on desktop; quick-approve on a blacklist row opens the dialog. On the Links tab, copy/share/poster (A4 PDF with the 3 steps and the link)/regenerate are present. Backend selfreg regression passed 31/31 and the new auth+selfreg-rules suite passed 13/13. Found 2 bugs in the global dialog CSS that affect dialogs OTHER than the invite wizard (see critical issues).

minor.issue: Leaves user test_gestor_selfreg@teste.com (company_manager) in the DB after the run. Deleted manually by the testing agent. Add a teardown.

The host page says the rejection reason 'será enviado ao visitante', but the status page for a 'recusado' request does not show it (only 'Em caso de dúvida, procure a recepção'). Show the reason if it is meant to reach the visitor here.

ui_bugs.component: DialogContent usages with a non-prefixed max-h class (CrudPage.jsx:173 'max-h-[85vh]', SelfRegAdmin.jsx:89 RequestDialog 'max-h-[92dvh]', equipment/ControllerDialog.jsx:131 'max-h-[90vh]')
ui_bugs.issue: These classes override the new mobile fullscreen h-[100dvh], so on phones these dialogs are NOT fullscreen. Empresas/all CRUD dialogs measured 567/844px tall, RequestDialog 613/667px. The page behind and the 'Convidar' FAB show through below the dialog. Fix: change to sm:max-h-[...] (or add max-sm:max-h-none in the base dialog).

The footer is sticky bottom-0 inside a scroll container that has p-6, combined with -mb-6. Chrome sticks the footer at the padding edge, so it is pushed up ~24px and leaves an empty band under the buttons. It also covers the last ~48px of the dialog body, and that part cannot be scrolled to (scrollHeight == clientHeight). Reproduced on desktop /areas 'Novo': the 'Fora do site' checkbox sits under the footer and cannot be reached. Also seen on the invite wizard step 0 (Tipo da visita select partly covered) and on the invite result (textarea visible below the footer). Same cause on mobile: header sticky top-0 with -mt-4 sits 16px low, and the footer floats 16px above the bottom edge. Fix: use bottom-[-1rem] sm:bottom-[-1.5rem] on the footer (and top-[-1rem] on the header) to match the container padding, or move the padding into an inner scroll body with p-0 on Content.

issues: The photo takes most of the first screen, so the host-decision-identity and host-decision-blacklist warnings are below the fold. The host can tap Aprovar (fixed footer) without seeing that the visitor is on the blacklist. Move the warnings above the photo or into the sticky footer area.

Field errors ('Digite um CPF válido', 'Digite seu nome completo') stay visible after the user fixes the field, until Continuar is pressed again. Clear each field's error onChange. The stale error also hides the inline 'CPF inválido. Confira os números.' message, because error has priority over bad.
The 'Compartilhar' label is cramped against its button border. The 'Baixar cartaz' button is partly covered by the floating Convidar FAB until you scroll.
The instruction 'Na chegada, olhe para o leitor facial' appears twice (green box and subtitle).
The 'Tipos de visita que a empresa pode usar' multiselect has the placeholder 'Buscar e selecionar categorias...' (copy-paste).
File is 1.9MB because the logo is embedded as an uncompressed PNG. Use JPEG or compress the logo.
Accents are stripped badly in the filename (cartaz-autocadastro-beta-manuten-o.pdf). Use normalize('NFD') before slugifying.
A load error falls back to the empty state ('Nenhuma solicitação') instead of an error state with retry.

Quick 'Liberar' skips the dialog only for blacklist rows. identity_check rows (CPF already registered, ownership not confirmed) are approved in one tap without the photo-comparison warning. Consider routing identity_check rows to the dialog too.

action_items: HIGH: Prefix the max-h classes on DialogContent with sm: in CrudPage.jsx:173, SelfRegAdmin.jsx:89 and ControllerDialog.jsx:131 (or neutralise them on mobile in dialog.jsx) so ALL dialogs are fullscreen on phones.

HIGH: Fix the sticky offsets in dialog.jsx. Footer: bottom-[-1rem] sm:bottom-[-1.5rem]. Header: top-[-1rem]. This stops the desktop footer from covering the last ~48px of content that cannot be scrolled to (e.g. /areas 'Fora do site').
MEDIUM: On /aprovar, show the blacklist and identity warnings above the photo, or keep them visible next to the approve footer.

LOW: Clear public field errors on change; remove the duplicated facial instruction; fix the 'Tipos de visita' placeholder; compress the poster logo and slugify accents; add an error state to the request queue; teardown test_gestor_selfreg in test_selfreg_flow.py.
critical_code_review_comments: dialog.jsx: sticky header/footer with negative margins inside a padded overflow container misaligns them in Chrome (sticky inset uses the padding box). Use inset values equal to the padding, or restructure into Content(p-0) > Header / Body(overflow-auto) / Footer.
Any DialogContent className containing max-h-/h- without the sm: prefix silently breaks the mobile fullscreen fix. Consider max-sm:!max-h-none in the base class.
SelfRegAdmin: the card and table views both render QuickActions, so every selfreg-quick-* testid exists twice in the DOM (one copy is hidden). Tests must scope to selfreg-row-/selfreg-trow-.
InviteWizard/SelfRegister: .sort() on step numbers is lexicographic. It works for 0-3 but is fragile; use (a, b) => a - b.

No public CPF lookup endpoint exists (verified: public routes are only info/hosts/otp/verify/submit/status/push/decision). Invites always produce 'pendente' (verified in the DB: source=convite, status=pendente).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all requested flows work; 2 HIGH dialog-layout bugs outside the invite wizard)

rca of the issue: Dialog bug 1: tailwind-merge keeps the caller's max-h-[85vh] next to the base h-[100dvh]. max-height wins, so the mobile 'fullscreen' dialog is only 85-92% tall. Dialog bug 2: Chrome resolves sticky offsets against the scroll container's content box (padding-inset). With footer bottom:0 and container padding p-6/p-4, the footer is pushed up by the padding plus its negative margin. It overlaps the end of the body without adding scroll overflow, so that content cannot be reached. Repro: desktop /areas > Novo; the 'Fora do site' checkbox is under the footer and the dialog's scrollHeight == clientHeight (333).
